title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: When you set the lineup
hook: Do you know your lineup before you get to the field?
intro: You planned the lineup the night before.
statement: A plan you can adjust beats no plan at all.
q1: Do you set the lineup the night before —
q2: or decide at the field based on who is there?
q3: How much time do you spend deciding at the field?
t1: Every coach is different. But game day feels calmer
t2: when you start with a plan.
cta: Coaches — when do you set your lineup?
ctaLines: Night before. At the field. A plan with backups.
ctaPrompt: Share your game-day habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Do you know your lineup before you get to the field?
You planned the lineup the night before. Two kids are out sick.
A plan you can adjust beats no plan at all.
The night before or at the field. There is no perfect answer.
When do you set your lineup? Share your habit in the comments.
